$comment:
FastUI Spec Schema — v2 (top-down composition model).

## PRIMITIVES
Every spec file has exactly one root key that selects its primitive:

  component   A renderable UI node (container, text, image, …).
              This is the most common primitive.

  condition   A two-branch conditional node. Renders `modifier.left`
              (true branch) or `modifier.right` (false branch) based
              on `modifier.states.condition`. Both branches are paths
              to sibling specs.

  loop        A repeating list node. Driven by `modifier.states.data`
              (an array). Each iteration renders the template spec
              referenced by `modifier.feed`. The template receives
              `inputs.loopElement` and `inputs.loopIndex`.

  surface     A full-screen surface (page or overlay). Describes
              navigation metadata — route name, presentation mode, etc.

## COMPOSITION MODEL (top-down)
Composition flows **downward** from parent to children.

  1. A composer spec sets `modifier.extend` to an ordered array of
     relative paths to its child specs. The generator renders each
     child inside the composer's layout according to `modifier.frame`.

  2. `modifier.frame` controls how the composer positions its own
     content alongside each extended child:
       base    — layout axis + direction + overlay mode.
                 Format: '<axis>.<direction>[.stack]'
                 axis      : row | column
                 direction : start | end
                 .stack    : optional — children overlap (z-stack)
       id      — optional identifier used when there are multiple
                 composers at the same level referencing each other.
       current — CSS styles applied to this node's own rendered view.
       next    — CSS styles applied uniformly to every extended child
                 wrapper.

  3. A spec can inherit another spec by setting `base` to a relative
     path ending in `.yml`. The resolved spec's `base` (primitive) and
     `modifier.styles` are inherited; the local `modifier` overrides
     and merges on top. INSTANCE specs always point `base` at their
     shared MAIN COMPONENT spec path.

## BASE TYPES
When `base` is a string primitive (not a path), it selects the
renderer:

  container   A generic box. Default for frames, groups, sections.
              Supports all CSS layout styles.

  text        A text node. Requires `modifier.props.children`.
              Supports typography CSS styles.

  image       An image node. Requires `modifier.props.src`.
              Supports size + objectFit styles.

## STYLES
`modifier.styles` (and `frame.current` / `frame.next`) accept either:
  - A CSS object (all standard CSS properties are valid — see $defs.css).
  - A logic reference string:  'logics.<functionName>'  resolved at
    runtime by the generated service file.

## ACTIONS
`modifier.props.onClick` (and other event props) accept an action
object:
  { action: 'state.set', target: '<stateName>', value: <any> }
  { action: 'navigation.open', name: '<routeName>', type: 'push'|'replace'|'sheet'|'dialog' }
  { action: 'navigation.back' }
  { action: 'navigation.close' }

## SURFACE
Used by the surface root to describe a page or overlay navigation
surface. Not rendered directly.

## EXAMPLE — multi-child column composer
```yaml
component:
  base: container
  modifier:
    extend:
      - ./header.yml
      - ./body.yml
      - ./footer.yml
    frame:
      base: column.start
      current:
        width: 100%
        height: 100%
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff'
      next:
        width: 100%
```

## EXAMPLE — instance reusing shared spec
```yaml
component:
  base: ../../shared/common/iprimary_button.yml
  modifier:
    styles:
      backgroundColor: '#0066ff'
    props:
      id: my-button
```

## EXAMPLE — condition
```yaml
condition:
  modifier:
    states:
      condition: false
    left: ./logged_in_view.yml
    right: ./logged_out_view.yml
```

## EXAMPLE — loop
```yaml
loop:
  modifier:
    states:
      data: []
    feed: ./list_item.yml
    props:
      scroll: vertical
```
title: FastUI Spec

frame_base_enum.$comment:
The eight valid frame.base tokens.
  row.start        — children placed left-to-right; current before extend children.
  row.end          — children placed left-to-right; extend children before current.
  column.start     — children placed top-to-bottom; current before extend children.
  column.end       — children placed top-to-bottom; extend children before current.
  *.stack variants — children overlap (z-stack / Stack widget); order is back-to-front.

frame_base_value.$comment:
The value of frame.base. Two forms:
1. String shorthand: one of the eight layout tokens (same as frame_base_enum).
2. Object form: { type: <token>, styles: <CSS object> } — `styles` are merged
   onto the outer `_base` container div/widget so you can size or decorate
   the outer composition shell directly without touching current or next.

type.$comment: The layout token. Same values as frame_base_enum.

styles.$comment: CSS styles applied to the outer `_base` container (the flex/grid shell that wraps all slots). Use for sizing (width, height, flex) or decorating the composition shell itself.

frame.$comment:
Layout contract for a composer node.
- base    : required — axis, direction, and optional stack overlay mode.
            String form: 'row.start' etc.
            Object form: { type: 'row.start', styles: {} } — styles go on the _base outer container.
- id      : optional — identifies this frame node for cross-composer referencing.
- current : CSS styles applied to this node's own rendered view/container.
- next    : CSS styles applied uniformly to every `extend` child's wrapper.

Shorthand: a plain string (one of the frame_base_enum values) is
equivalent to { base: <value>, current: {}, next: {} }.

id.$comment: Optional identifier. Must be unique among sibling composers if used.

current.$comment: CSS styles for THIS node's own rendered view (not children).

next.$comment: CSS styles applied to the wrapper of EVERY extended child.

local_path.$comment: A relative path to a sibling or ancestor spec file. Must end in .yml or .yaml.

local_path_or_array.$comment:
extend accepts a single path OR an ordered array of paths.
Single path: the composer has exactly one extended child.
Array: the composer has multiple children rendered in listed order
       according to frame.base direction. The generator respects this
       order — do not re-order unless you want the layout to change.

styles_value.$comment:
Either a plain CSS object or a logic-reference string.
  CSS object     — standard CSS property names in camelCase.
  Logic ref      — 'logics.<name>' resolved by the generated service.
                   The generator calls the service function with the
                   component context and inlines the return value.

oneOf.description: Logic or service function reference. Format: 'logics.<functionName>'.

target.$comment: For state.set: name of the state key to update.

value.$comment: For state.set: the value to assign. Can be a literal or 'event.value'.

name.$comment: For navigation.open: the route name to navigate to.

type.$comment: For navigation.open: how the route is presented.

translation_binding.$comment: Reactive localized text resolved from the active locale, then the default catalog, then the exact key. fallback is catalog-generation metadata and is never rendered directly.

props.$comment:
Props are platform-neutral attributes passed to the rendered primitive.
Common props shared across all component types:

id.$comment: DOM/widget identifier. Can reference state: 'states.<name>' or inputs.

children.$comment: Inline text content, a state/input reference, or a reactive translation binding.

onClick.$comment: Action triggered when the user taps/clicks this node.

onChange.$comment: Action triggered when an input value changes.

src.$comment:
Image source URL. Required for base: image. Can be a static path,
a loop element reference ('inputs.loopElement.<field>'), or a state.

control.$comment: Set to 'input' to render as a native input control inside a container.

type.$comment: Input type when control: input is set.

value.$comment: Controlled value for an input. Typically 'states.value'.

placeholder.$comment: Placeholder text for an input control.

href.$comment: URL to navigate to when the element is tapped/clicked. React: renders as <a href>. Flutter: GestureDetector + url_launcher. Mutually exclusive with onClick navigation actions.

target.$comment: Link target. React: HTML target attribute on <a>. Flutter: ignored (all links open externally).

disabled.$comment: Disables interaction with the element. React: HTML disabled attribute. Flutter: wraps in IgnorePointer.

checked.$comment: Controlled checked state for checkbox/radio inputs. React: HTML checked attribute. Flutter: passed as initial value.

label.$comment: Accessible label for the element. React: maps to aria-label. Flutter: Semantics.label.

role.$comment: ARIA role. React: HTML role attribute. Flutter: mapped to Semantics properties (button, link, image, header).

maxLength.$comment: Maximum character length for input controls.

autoFocus.$comment: Whether the element should automatically receive focus on mount. React: HTML autofocus. Flutter: FocusNode.requestFocus in initState.

onFocus.$comment: Action triggered when the element receives focus.

onBlur.$comment: Action triggered when the element loses focus.

onLongPress.$comment: Action triggered on a long press/tap. React: onMouseDown hold approximation. Flutter: GestureDetector.onLongPress.

onSubmit.$comment: Action triggered when a form or input is submitted (Enter key). React: onSubmit. Flutter: TextFormField.onFieldSubmitted.

itemKey.$comment: Stable key expression for loop provider identity. Falls back to item _key, id, key, then index.

onMouseEnter.$comment: Action triggered when the pointer enters the element. React: onMouseEnter. Flutter: MouseRegion.onEnter.

onMouseLeave.$comment: Action triggered when the pointer leaves the element. React: onMouseLeave. Flutter: MouseRegion.onExit.

states_map.$comment:
Local reactive state for this component. Keys are state names,
values are initial values. Any state can be referenced in styles,
props, or children as 'states.<name>'.

State changes are triggered by actions (e.g. onClick: state.set).
For toggle/boolean state, use { variant: '<stateName>', action: 'state.set' }.

effects_map.$comment:
Side-effects run on component mount or when dependencies change.
Keys are effect names, values describe the trigger and logic.
Generated as useEffect (React) or initState (Flutter).

metadata.$comment:
Internal translator metadata — not emitted to generated code.
Used by the Figma translator to attach surface presentation info
and other non-generatable context.

component_modifier.$comment:
Modifier for a component spec. All fields are optional except where
noted. Mandatory fields depend on the component base type:
  base: text   — props.children is expected (may be dynamic via states/inputs)
  base: image  — props.src is required
  base: container with extend — frame.base is strongly recommended
                                to define the layout direction.

extend.$comment:
COMPOSITION: ordered list of child spec paths this component renders
as top-down children. The composer passes its state and view context
down to each child. Children's own prop contracts are unchanged.
A single path or an array of paths is accepted.

styles.$comment: Visual styles for this node's own rendered container/widget.

props.$comment: Props passed to the rendered primitive (id, children, onClick, src, …).

states.$comment: Local reactive state. Initial values. Referenced as 'states.<name>'.

effects.$comment: Side-effect declarations run on mount or dependency change.

frame.$comment:
REQUIRED when extend is set. Defines the layout axis, direction, and
per-layer styles for this composer. Omit on leaf nodes (no children).

component_root.$comment:
A renderable UI node. The most common spec primitive.

Mandatory: base (string primitive OR relative .yml path)
Mandatory: modifier (even if empty: {})

--- Primitives ---
  base: container  Generic box/frame. Use for layout wrappers and groups.
                   Use with modifier.extend + modifier.frame to compose children.

  base: text       Text node. modifier.props.children is the text content.
                   Content may be a literal, a 'states.<name>' reference,
                   or an 'inputs.<name>' reference (for loop templates).

  base: image      Image node. modifier.props.src is the image URL.
                   modifier.props.alt is the accessible label.

--- Shared spec inheritance ---
  base: ../../shared/common/iprimary_button.yml
                   Inherits that spec's primitive and styles. Local modifier
                   overrides and merges on top. Used for INSTANCE nodes that
                   reuse a shared MAIN COMPONENT spec.

base.$comment:
Either a primitive type name OR a relative path to another spec file.
  Primitive: 'container' | 'text' | 'image'
  Shared spec: relative path ending in .yml or .yaml
                e.g. '../../shared/common/iprimary_button.yml'

oneOf.description: Relative path to a shared spec to inherit from.

condition_root.$comment:
A conditional branch node. Renders `modifier.left` when
`modifier.states.condition` is truthy, `modifier.right` otherwise.

Mandatory: modifier (with at least one of left/right)
Mandatory: modifier.states.condition (initial boolean)

Both left and right must be relative paths to sibling specs.
The condition state is toggled by state.set actions.

Example:
  condition:
    modifier:
      states:
        condition: false
      left: ./logged_in.yml
      right: ./logged_out.yml
      frame:
        base: column.start
        current:
          width: 100%

left.$comment: Path to the spec rendered when condition is TRUE.

right.$comment: Path to the spec rendered when condition is FALSE.

states.$comment:
Must include 'condition' key with an initial boolean value.
May include additional state keys used by the rendered branches.

styles.$comment: Styles for the outer wrapper that contains the active branch.

loop_root.$comment:
A repeating list node. Renders `modifier.feed` once per item in
`modifier.states.data`. The feed spec receives the loop context:
  inputs.loopElement  — the current item object
  inputs.loopIndex    — the current zero-based index

Mandatory: modifier.feed (path to the item template spec)
Mandatory: modifier.states.data (initial array, may be empty)

Example:
  loop:
    modifier:
      states:
        data: []
      feed: ./list_item.yml
      props:
        scroll: vertical
        id: product-list
      styles:
        width: 100%
        flex: 1

feed.$comment:
REQUIRED. Relative path to the item template spec file.
This spec will be rendered once per element in states.data.
The template should declare 'loopElement' and 'loopIndex' inputs.

styles.$comment: Styles for the loop container (the scrollable list wrapper).

props.$comment: Props for the loop container. scroll controls scroll direction.

itemKey.$comment: Optional item field used first for stable component instance identity. Falls back to _key, id, key, then index.

states.$comment:
Must include 'data' key with initial array value.
The generator subscribes to this state to drive re-renders.

surface_root.$comment:
Describes a navigation surface (page or overlay). Not rendered directly.
Used by the routing generator to build the app route table and the
Flutter FastUINavigation runtime.

Mandatory: modifier.name (route name used in navigation.open actions)
Mandatory: modifier.mode

Modes:
  page     — a full-screen surface pushed onto the navigation stack.
  overlay  — floats above the current surface.
  sheet    — bottom/top/side sheet presentation.
  dialog   — modal dialog.

Example:
  surface:
    modifier:
      name: choices
      mode: overlay
      scroll: none
      safeArea: false
      barrierColor: '#00000066'
      width: 100%
      height: 360

name.$comment: REQUIRED. The route name referenced by navigation.open actions.

mode.$comment: REQUIRED. How this surface is presented in the navigation stack.

scroll.$comment: Scroll behaviour of the surface content.

safeArea.$comment: Whether the surface respects device safe-area insets (notch, home bar).

barrierColor.$comment: Background barrier color for overlays/sheets/dialogs (CSS color string).

barrierDismissible.$comment: Whether tapping the barrier dismisses the surface.

width.$comment: Explicit width of the surface content area.

height.$comment: Explicit height of the surface content area.

transition.$comment: Transition animation type for route entry.

durationMs.$comment: Duration of the transition animation in milliseconds.

opacity.$comment: Element opacity 0.0 (transparent) – 1.0 (opaque). Flutter maps to Opacity widget; React maps to CSS opacity.

backgroundColor.$comment: Background fill color. Accepts hex (#RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA), rgba(), or named CSS color. Flutter: BoxDecoration.color. React: CSS backgroundColor.

background.$comment: CSS background shorthand — used as a backgroundColor alias when no image/gradient is needed. Flutter: same as backgroundColor. React: CSS background.

padding.$comment: CSS padding shorthand: '8', '8 16', '8 16 8', or '8 16 8 16' (top right bottom left). Accepts px suffix. Flutter: Container.padding. React: CSS padding.

margin.$comment: CSS margin shorthand. Same syntax as padding. Flutter: Container.margin. React: CSS margin.

marginTop.$comment: Top margin. Overrides margin shorthand top value.

marginRight.$comment: Right margin. Overrides margin shorthand right value.

marginBottom.$comment: Bottom margin. Overrides margin shorthand bottom value.

marginLeft.$comment: Left margin. Overrides margin shorthand left value.

fontWeight.$comment: Font weight. Number 100–900 or named keyword. Flutter: FontWeight.wN. React: CSS fontWeight.

fontStyle.$comment: Font style. Flutter: FontStyle.italic / FontStyle.normal. React: CSS fontStyle.

lineHeightPx.$comment: FastUI-specific: absolute line height in pixels. Flutter maps to TextStyle.height = lineHeightPx / fontSize. React: use lineHeight instead.

objectFit.$comment: How an image fills its box. Flutter: BoxFit enum. React: CSS object-fit.

backdropFilter.$comment: CSS backdrop-filter (e.g. 'blur(8px)'). Flutter: BackdropFilter + ImageFilter.blur. React: CSS backdrop-filter.

WebkitBackdropFilter.$comment: WebKit vendor-prefixed alias for backdropFilter. Used as fallback in Safari/older browsers. Flutter treats identically to backdropFilter.

flex.$comment: CSS flex grow factor shorthand (number). Flutter: Expanded(flex: value). React: CSS flex.

flexDirection.$comment: Flex axis direction. Flutter: Row vs Column. React: CSS flex-direction.

flexWrap.$comment: Whether flex items wrap. Flutter: Wrap widget. React: CSS flex-wrap.

gap.$comment: Uniform spacing between flex/grid children. Flutter: SizedBox spacers. React: CSS gap.

rowGap.$comment: Vertical gap between flex rows. Flutter: column spacing. React: CSS row-gap.

alignItems.$comment: Cross-axis child alignment. Flutter: CrossAxisAlignment. React: CSS align-items.

justifyContent.$comment: Main-axis child distribution. Flutter: MainAxisAlignment. React: CSS justify-content.

alignSelf.$comment: Cross-axis alignment override for a single child. Flutter: Align widget. React: CSS align-self.

position.$comment: CSS positioning scheme. Flutter: Stack + Positioned for absolute; ignored for static/relative. React: CSS position.

overflow.$comment: Content overflow handling. 'hidden' → ClipRect/ClipRRect in Flutter; passed through in React.

overflowX.$comment: Horizontal overflow handling. Flutter: approximated by overflow.

overflowY.$comment: Vertical overflow handling. Flutter: approximated by overflow.

boxShadow.$comment: CSS box-shadow string (e.g. '0 2 8 rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'). Flutter: BoxDecoration.boxShadow. React: CSS box-shadow.

textDecoration.$comment: Text decoration line. Flutter: TextDecoration enum. React: CSS text-decoration.

textTransform.$comment: Text case transformation. Flutter: applied via String methods at build time. React: CSS text-transform.

whiteSpace.$comment: White-space handling. Flutter: Text.softWrap / Text.overflow mapping. React: CSS white-space.

display.$comment: CSS display mode. React: CSS display. Flutter: ignored (layout controlled by frame.base).

spaceValue.$comment: FastUI-specific: uniform gap (in px) injected as SizedBox spacers between Row/Column children. Equivalent to CSS gap in a frame context.

fallbackWidth.$comment: FastUI-specific: fallback pixel width used when the parent has no bounded width constraint. Prevents zero-size layout in Flutter when width: '100%'.

fallbackHeight.$comment: FastUI-specific: fallback pixel height used when the parent has no bounded height constraint. Prevents zero-size layout in Flutter when height: '100%'.
